A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
